name: MineDance2025
summary: Feel the rhythm and master the moves in MineDance2025! MineDance2025 is a music and dance game designed for those who love rhythm, fun, and challenges. Get into the groove, stay on beat, and show off your skills in high-energy performances. This game uses your device's camera solely to detect dance movements during gameplay. No images or videos are recorded, stored, or shared. With simple and engaging gameplay, MineDance2025 is perfect whether you want to play casually or focus on improving your precision and score with every dance. Welcome to MineDance2025! Get ready to find your rhythm and put your skills to the test in a dynamic, immersive dance game.
